f.title: Collect AE information, analyse impact and send to Thai FDA within set time frames

rows.quote_en: The persons with the duty to submit the summary report are the ministries, departments, Thai Red Cross Society and GPO that produce or import modern drugs, sending it to the Thai FDA within the following time frames: 1) analysis results and recommendations on adverse events occurring January to June shall be reported within August; 2) analysis results and recommendations on adverse events occurring July to December shall be reported within February of the following year.

f.title: Use AE online reporting or HPVC-Form 1 by post or e-mail
f.statement: Reports may be submitted via the HPVC AE online reporting system, or on HPVC-Form 1 (downloadable from the HPVC website) sent by post, by hand to the Strategy and Planning Division, or by e-mail; the Annex 5 summary report form is sent the same way.

rows.quote_en: 9.1 Adverse drug event reports: persons with the duty to submit reports may choose one of 2 channels: 1) via the AE online reporting system of the Health Product Vigilance Center (HPVC); or 2) using the Health Product Adverse Event Report form (HPVC Form-1, version 1 or 2; if you fill in and save the file in version 1, it can be imported into the AE online reporting system) of the Thai FDA, downloadable from the HPVC website https://hpvcth.fda.moph.go.th/, and send the form to the HPVC.
